name: How long does a typical remodeling consultation last?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical remodeling consultation last?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical home remodeling consultation usually lasts between one to two hours. This timeframe allows the contractor sufficient opportunity to walk through your home, understand your project vision, discuss your needs and budget, and answer any questions you may have. It also provides time for the contractor to offer preliminary insights and recommendations. The exact duration can depend on the complexity of your project and the level of detail discussed during the meeting.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical remodeling consultation lasts one to two hours, allowing time for project discussion, assessment, and answering questions.
